about: Places the outdoor areas (regions) and indoor rooms in one big grid. Each region file in world/regions holds a text map; this file says where it goes.

mapKey.:: sand, dirt path or tilled field
mapKey.b: bushes (a forest wall you can't walk through)

routes.about: Locked ways that open during the story. A quest, dialogue or chest opens one with the effect { "type": "unlock", "route": "<id>" }; blockers in a region's "entities" use "hiddenWhen": { "route": "<id>" } to move out of the way.

lockedSay: A BIG MOSSY LOG IS IN THE WAY.
